name: CodeSimpleQA
abstract: CodeSimpleQA evaluates factual programming knowledge in English and Chinese. This page reports a bilingual mean F1 derived by averaging the English and Chinese Avg. columns in the arXiv paper's Tables 3 and 4.
contributions: The benchmark contains 1,498 human-curated question-answer pairs grounded in programming and computer-science documentation.
Its bilingual coverage spans English and Chinese, more than 15 programming languages, and 21 computer-science domains.
The paper separates factual code knowledge from code-generation execution and also releases a 66.9M-example instruction corpus for training.
method: CodeSimpleQA contains 782 English and 716 Chinese question-answer pairs whose answers are verified against authoritative technical sources.
Questions cover programming languages, frameworks, systems, algorithms, databases, software engineering, security, and other computer-science topics.
The paper reports F1 by domain and an overall Avg. for each language in Tables 3 and 4.
For one bilingual leaderboard, TokenWave takes the arithmetic mean of each model's English Avg. and Chinese Avg.; this derived score is not a separate metric reported by the paper.

metrics.name: Bilingual mean F1
metrics.note: TokenWave-derived arithmetic mean of the English Avg. and Chinese Avg. F1 columns reported in arXiv Tables 3 and 4.

leaderboard_note: Each score is the arithmetic mean of the paper's English Avg. and Chinese Avg. F1 values. It is a transparent TokenWave aggregation of arXiv Tables 3 and 4, not a separately reported paper metric.

at_a_glance.setting: Mean of English and Chinese Avg. F1
